name: Nihiki no Marionette ~Kouki Naru Shimai no Songen Houkai~
original_name: 二美姫のマリオネット～高貴なる姉妹の尊厳崩壊～
source:
Endless lust and the trampling of dignity fall upon the princess sisters captured in the revolution!

The Kingdom of Féleschelle had sung of prosperity while living off the blessings of its colonies. But the royal family and the military clashed over colonial independence policy. As a result, the hardline colonial faction of the army overthrew the royal house in a coup!
The military “re-educates” the members of the royal family, symbols of the people’s authority and carries out a plan to remake them into loyal puppets.

Among them are the beautiful princess sisters who were meant to carry the next generation of the kingdom!
The first princess, Filia, neat, proud, and deeply trusted by the people is taken as a hostage for her family and her subjects. Her voluptuous body is relentlessly violated.

Her lofty spirit is eaten away by shame through brutal training!
The arrogant, strong-willed second princess, Elna, is also threatened and shown violence. Forced into submission, her dazzling body is violated.

She is humiliated not only by soldiers but by those who hold personal grudges against her, and unwanted carnal pleasure is planted in both her body and mind.
The noble princesses’ beautiful bodies and lofty spirits are thoroughly trampled and driven mad by extreme lust…

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/nihiki.html]official website[/url]]
